text:
I am writing to formally complain about extremely poor service we received at McDonald’s Waterfront on Christmas Day.

A staff member named Udi, who was working behind the counter, initially refused to assist us at the till when we attempted to order five ice-cream sundaes. The order was eventually processed by another cashier and paid in two separate transactions (one sundae and four sundaes).

Udi was later responsible for preparing drinks and ice creams. The single sundae was received within approximately two minutes, however the remaining four sundaes took over 20 minutes to be prepared.

Due to the excessive delay, I asked another lady behind the counter if she could please assist us. She kindly stepped in to help. When Udi approached her, he stated that the sundaes were “the ones I didn’t want to make,” which strongly suggested that our order had been deliberately delayed. This comment made us feel uncomfortable and hesitant about consuming the ice cream.

Additionally, when we first entered the restaurant, I witnessed the same staff member being rude to an elderly gentleman who was enquiring about milk. Instead of explaining the situation calmly, he raised his voice at the customer, which was completely inappropriate.

This behaviour was unprofessional, disrespectful, and unacceptable—especially on Christmas Day, when customers are simply trying to enjoy a meal with their families. I believe this matter warrants investigation and appropriate corrective action.

I trust that McDonald’s values customer service and will address this issue accordingly.
author: Veruschka May

text:
⭐ 1-Star Review ⭐
Absolutely unacceptable treatment from staff tonight.

I went to this McDonald’s with my boyfriend and a friend. They were closing up, so we quietly asked if we could use the bathroom while our friend was speaking to one of the staff about ice cream. Instead of a simple, polite “Sorry, we’re closed” or “The bathrooms aren’t available right now,” one of the employees yelled at us for walking toward the back.

We immediately apologized and turned around to leave, but he carried on loudly, repeating that they “don’t have a bathroom” and that it was “their time, not customers’ time.” The attitude was completely unnecessary. We weren’t rude, demanding, or causing trouble — we simply didn’t know, and we apologized right away.

I told him he didn’t need to treat us like that, because honestly, he didn’t. If he had spoken to us respectfully from the start, this situation would have gone very differently. No one deserves to be yelled at or spoken down to for a misunderstanding.

Very disappointed with the customer service. Even at closing time, basic respect is not optional.
author: Ane Rossouw

text:
I wait 1 hour and 20 minutes to get my order.
After an hour I ask if they know if my order will arrive soon. The server said he will asked the manager, he try to do my order but he was not allowed to do so… The « manager » came, she told me that i already eat my order and i try to get another one. She said she is going to watch at the cameras to see if i was lying. But i was waiting at the counter this whole time. I was really mad but she never come back from the back of the restaurant. Finally 20 minutes later, another manager came and make my order but he didn’t apologise or give me anything for compensation. He also forget sauces. That’s very disappointing. Who ever manage this restaurant you should improve the delivery and fire her. Here my ticket with my order that i get one hour and twenty minutes later. Don’t call this restaurant « fast food ».
author: Firof
